filesChanged: docs/kubernetes.md — the moved-address paragraph splits an issue pod from the controller's pod; the issue_volume paragraph gives the disk size to the update round.
trickyParts: The distinction the document has to carry is not 'which facets moved' but 'which of them a worker can be asked about first'. A launcher that dials a stale stream never redials, so its roles never reach the daemon to be tasked; the layout before one container holds workers that predate the op. Those two stay a launch's, for every pod. The other three leave the workers running and reachable, so they are a round's — except over a pod no round covers, where movedInPod holds all five and the launch replaces it as it always did.
